summary: Verified iter11 fixes: multi-file upload from OS explorer via input[multiple], 50MB upload limit, PDF auto-compression >10MB, drop-on-folder handler wiring. Backend pytest 6/6 pass (login, single upload, sequential multi-upload, >50MB rejected 400 with '50MB' text, 11MB PDF accepted via compression path, folder create+upload+list). Frontend Playwright on Empresa Test Demo: DocumentFolders renders with data-testid, both file inputs have multiple=true with accept covering pdf/img/word/excel, create-folder-btn -> folder-name-input -> submit-folder-btn creates and shows folder in grid, uploading 2 PDFs via set_input_files results in 2 new doc rows (doc-{id}) appearing. Synthetic dragover event did NOT toggle 'Suelta los archivos' text (React state didn't update from JSDOM-style DataTransfer). Handler code is present and correct (onDragOver checks e.dataTransfer.types.includes('Files')) - real native OS drag events would work. Cannot fully automate native explorer drag; verified handlers + data-testid presence per request.

issues: ClientDashboard.js lines 101 and 354 still show 'Max 5MB' text to end clients — inconsistent with new 50MB limit. Not part of Empresa flow but likely should also be raised to 50MB for consistency.
Radix Dialog missing Description/aria-describedby a11y warning (carried from iter10, non-blocking)

action_items: (Consistency, out of scope but flagged) ClientDashboard.js lines 101, 354 still say 'Max 5MB' — update to 50MB to match new limit if clients should also get the raised limit.

(Optional) The 'Suelta los archivos aqui' text-swap only shows when docs.length===0 && folders.length===0 (empty state). When folders/docs exist, the outer wrapper still gets ring-2 ring-sky-400 bg-sky-50/50 on drag, but no text change. Consider also toggling a small overlay text when dragging over a non-empty folder view for consistent UX.
critical_code_review_comments: DocumentFolders.js handleUpload uploads files sequentially in a for-loop — for multi-file drops of many files this is slow. Consider Promise.all with a small concurrency cap (e.g., 3) for better UX.
The onDrop handler on folder cards (line 261-287) inlines an async uploadToFolder function duplicating handleUpload logic — extract to a shared helper accepting (files, folderIdOverride) to DRY.

server.py _auto_compress_pdf: if all size targets fail, returns `result, True` from the last iteration (line 604) which may be LARGER than max_bytes; subsequent size-check is bypassed since compress happens after the 50MB gate. Fine for correctness but consider returning original if none fit under target.

context_for_next_testing_agent: iter11 verified: 50MB backend limit works, PDF auto-compress path runs, multi-file uploads work via input[multiple]. Native OS drag/drop from file explorer cannot be simulated via Playwright — only handler wiring was verified (handlers exist on both drop zone and folder cards, check dataTransfer.types for 'Files'). If retesting, note that the Suelta text swap only appears in EMPTY state (both docs & folders empty). API base: https://inmigra-docs.preview.emergentagent.com. Login response uses key 'token' not 'access_token'. /api/auth/login is admin-only (line 505).
rca of the issue: Not a bug fix verification — feature verification. Original user complaint 'dragging multiple files doesn't work' fixed by (1) adding onDragOver/onDrop with e.dataTransfer.files to the container div wrapping docs list, (2) mirroring drop handler on each folder card so drop-onto-folder uploads directly with folder_id, (3) input already had `multiple` attr — retained. Backend size cap raised from 10MB -> 50MB across all upload endpoints (lines 780, 1238, 1711, 2654, 2773) and _auto_compress_pdf(max_bytes=10MB) invoked for PDF>10MB using PyMuPDF rasterisation to JPEGs.
